Class MeshMessage

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.model.MeshMessage
public class MeshMessage extends Object
Meshtastic chat message, either channel-based or direct.

Holds text, addressing, delivery status, and routing metadata. Outgoing messages are created by MessageService; incoming messages are created by MessageListenerService. The status field is volatile so transport-reader updates are visible to the UI thread.

  • Constructor Details

    • MeshMessage

      public MeshMessage(String fromNodeId, String toNodeId, int channelIndex, String text, long timestamp, boolean outgoing)
      Creates a message with its core fields.
      Parameters:
      fromNodeId - sender node id, for example "!9e755af0"
      toNodeId - recipient node id, with "!ffffffff" meaning broadcast
      channelIndex - channel index, where 0 is primary
      text - UTF-8 message text
      timestamp - epoch time in seconds
      outgoing - true when the message was sent from this device

    • hasValidHopData

      public boolean hasValidHopData()
      Returns whether hop count can be calculated safely. hopLimit must not exceed the original hopStart; otherwise the pair is treated as invalid and ignored by the UI.
      Returns:
      true when hop data is present and internally consistent

    • getHopsTraveled

      public int getHopsTraveled()
      Calculates how many hops the message has traversed. The value is hopStart - hopLimit; missing or invalid data returns 0.
      Returns:
      hop count, or 0 when unavailable
